title: Owner: refresh the overview from chat and see the hourly job run
goal: The owner asks NERV to refresh the overview, approves it, sees the run finish, and checks the hourly job and GitHub's backup schedule
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the update: "Refresh the overview" in chat shows an approval card; after approval the coordinator refresh-views run starts and NERV reports its result and link
With the hourly job turned on and the pilot promoted, runs appear about hourly in voidbrain/coordinator Actions; GitHub's own schedule still runs as the backup
privacy: Neutral invented repositories, workflows and runs in tests; the GitHub token never in git, config.json, tests, logs, chat or the relocation snapshot.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-132 Verification
escalation: The owner decides whether the hourly job stays on

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one chat request and a look at the Actions page after an hour. Not a measurement.
